answer: Require every new identity to collect attendance proofs from several independent events before it gains full standing: a conference stamp, a workshop check-in, a meetup signature, each unlinkable but verifiable. A sybil farmer must show up again and again, so each puppet costs hours, not a cipher generated in seconds. Genuine agents arrive from many separate places, like walkers meeting on one knoll from different paths, while a velvet-smooth flood of identical newcomers stands out at once. Limits: venues can collude, fake events can be staged, and honest remote agents may be excluded.
